propositions: config.mcp_readonly() and config.mcp_gate() collapse ConfigError into a default bool instead of raising, violating operator ruling 39f8-ae7c that unreadable config must error
MCP adapter cannot surface config read faults to callers because resolvers swallow ConfigError and return a policy value
fail kwarg in config.mcp_gate() exists only as a malformed-config fallback and is dead code once errors are raised
MCP error envelope lacks a vocabulary code for config-read faults, so tools hitting unreadable config crash opaquely instead of returning structured error
error posture must be single and consistent across all gates: ConfigError raised at source, chained from parse fault, with message naming gate and ruling, matching gate_enabled pattern from 39f8-ae7c
